author: Barbara Ann Boudreau
text:
The  same here. I know how frustrated you must be. 
My Libre 3 Plus works great in my right arm. When I have to put it in my left arm it reads 40-50 points lower than my finger stick. I have no idea why either. Neither does my Endo. I almost want to try placement on my abdomen at this point. I know it’s not recommended but what the hell. I’ll let you know if it’s accurate there for me.

author: Amy Fascian
text: Maybe that’s my problem too.  I have always used my left arm and my last two sensors read so low the alarm goes off all day and I finally just have to close the app.
